channel.title: Shelby Ceramic Coating Journal
channel.description: Guides to ceramic coating, car detailing and mobile paint protection from Shelby Ceramic Coating.

item.title: What does ceramic coating do?
item.description: Ceramic coating adds a bonded protective layer to a vehicle’s paint. It can add gloss, water repellency and make regular cleaning easier, but it does not make paint damage-proof.

item.title: Is ceramic coating scratch-proof?
item.description: No. Ceramic coating does not make car paint scratch-proof and it will not stop stone chips. Careful washing and realistic expectations still matter.

item.title: Ceramic coating or car wax: what is the difference?
item.description: Wax and ceramic coating are different paint-care options. Wax is usually a shorter-term finish, while a professional ceramic coating is designed to bond to prepared paint and last longer.

item.title: Why does paint preparation matter before ceramic coating?
item.description: Paint preparation matters because a coating follows the surface it is applied to. Cleaning and suitable paint correction help prepare the finish before coating.

item.title: Is ceramic coating a good choice for a black car?
item.description: A ceramic coating can suit a black car, but it will not hide existing swirls or scratches. Paint condition and preparation should be discussed before the coating is applied.

item.title: How should you wash a ceramic-coated car?
item.description: Wash a coated car with clean tools and follow the aftercare instructions supplied for the coating. Avoid dragging dirt across the paint and clean heavy contamination promptly.

item.title: When can you wash your car after ceramic coating?
item.description: The safe wait time depends on the coating product and application conditions. Follow the product-specific aftercare instructions from your installer.

item.title: Can ceramic coating protect paint from bird droppings and tree sap?
item.description: A ceramic coating can help with routine cleaning, but it does not make paint immune to bird droppings, sap or other contaminants. Remove them promptly using suitable care instructions.

item.title: Is ceramic coating worth it for a daily driver?
item.description: Ceramic coating may suit a daily driver if you value gloss, water repellency and easier routine cleaning. Whether it is worth the cost depends on your car, budget and care habits.

item.title: How do you prepare for a mobile ceramic coating booking?
item.description: Share your suburb, vehicle details and the available work area when you request a mobile booking. Shelby will confirm whether the setup suits the service.
